name: reach
description: Read, search and edit files on your Reach Engine devices through your Gateway.

REACH_GATEWAY_URL.title: Reach Gateway URL
REACH_GATEWAY_URL.description: Public HTTPS Gateway root, for example https://reach.example.com. Omit the trailing slash and path.

REACH_CONTROLLER_TOKEN.title: Reach Controller token
REACH_CONTROLLER_TOKEN.description: Private Controller token, not the Engine token. Authorizes reads and writes across all registered Engine workspaces. Never share or echo it.
